high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie indoors. The individual is wearing a black sleeveless shirt and has a red string with a small pendant around their neck. They have short dark hair and a mustache. On the left side of their upper arm, there is a visible tattoo. The background reveals a room with a wardrobe on the left side, which appears to be open, revealing some clothes inside. There is also a window with a curtain that has a pattern of gold and black swirls. The curtain is partially drawn, allowing light to enter the room.
